activity.role: Court painter and creator of Las Meninas
activity.notes: Representative historical PERSON-SPECIFIC milestone point (not a claim of a single year of career). Painting Las Meninas completed around 1656 at the Spanish Habsburg royal court. The famous court painting is an individual cultural milestone; painter Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez (1599–1660) is NOT conquistador Diego Velázquez de Cuéllar (circa1465–1524). No state governing Activity.
